findings.message: Alt text for fig-2 is too thin or generic.
findings.evidence: Detected 4 words and generic visual phrasing.
findings.remediation: Describe the key variables, trend, and scientific conclusion without relying on sight.

findings.message: Complex figure fig-2 lacks a long description or data summary.
findings.evidence: Dense scientific visualizations need a structured non-visual explanation.
findings.remediation: Add a long description or machine-readable data summary for complex figures.

findings.message: Artifact fig-2 relies on color-only interpretation.
findings.evidence: Color-only distinctions are not accessible to all readers or output formats.
findings.remediation: Add shape, pattern, label, or textual encoding alongside color.

findings.message: Alt text for fig-2 was reviewed against an older source artifact.
findings.evidence: Expected source hash sha256:map-current; found sha256:map-old.
findings.remediation: Regenerate or re-approve alt text after the source data or rendering changes.

findings.message: Alt text for fig-2 predates the latest artifact edit.
findings.evidence: Artifact updated at 2026-05-31T18:00:00.000Z; alt text reviewed at 2026-05-31T17:00:00.000Z.

findings.message: Blocking accessibility comment remains open on fig-2.
findings.evidence: Alt text must describe the nutrient gradient and not just the visual map.

findings.message: Alt text changed inside locked section results without approval.
findings.evidence: Final review locks should protect export wording for scientific artifacts.
findings.remediation: Collect a locked-section accessibility approval or reopen the section for review.

findings.message: Artifact fig-2 has no accessible-export approval.
